help.text: Here is what I can do:

invite.description: Invite friends and see how many people you have invited

link.description: Link your accounts in different messengers
link.code:
Your code: {{code}}
Send “/link {{code}}” to the bot in another messenger before {{time}}, {{date}}. The code works once
link.confirm: The group and settings of this account will be replaced by those of the account where you got the code. Continue?
link.done: Done, your accounts are linked. Notifications will go to the messenger you last wrote to the bot in
link.invalidCode: The code is unknown or has expired. Get a new one: send “/link” in the other messenger
link.ownCode: This code belongs to this account. Send it to the bot in another messenger
link.platformTaken: Both accounts already have a profile in the same messenger, and each messenger allows only one profile
link.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Try again later
